    AI Mode reply for youtube

    YouTube is an American online video-sharing platform owned by Google. 
    Overview of YouTube
    • Founders: Steve Chen, Chad Hurley, and Jawed Karim founded the platform on February 14, 2005.
    • Headquarters: San Bruno, California.
    • Usage: It is the second-most-visited website globally, with over 2.7 billion monthly active users. 
    Key Services
    • YouTube Premium: Removes ads and supports background or offline playback.
    • YouTube Music: Focuses on ad-free listening to millions of songs and albums.
    • YouTube Kids: Offers a safer, controlled viewing environment for younger children.
    • YouTube TV: Provides live television and sports streaming in the United States.
